features.name: Create New Note
features.description: User creates a new markdown note
features.user_journey: Project → Notes → Click 'New Note'

features.name: Edit Note with BlockNote
features.description: User edits note content using Notion-like block editor
features.user_journey: Notes → Click note → Edit content

features.name: Delete Note
features.description: User deletes a note from project
features.user_journey: Notes → Right-click note → Delete

features.name: Auto-Save Note
features.description: Note content auto-saves with 500ms debounce
features.user_journey: Notes → Edit content → Auto-saves

features.name: Markdown Import
features.description: Import markdown files into notes
features.user_journey: Notes → Click Import → Select .md file

features.name: Markdown Export
features.description: Export notes as markdown files

features.name: File Sync (FSA ↔ IndexedDB)

features.name: RAG Indexing
features.description: Index notes for Knowledge workspace search
features.user_journey: Notes → Click Index button

features.name: Note Search
features.description: Search notes by title/content with debouncing
features.user_journey: Notes → Type in search box → Results appear

features.name: Note Favorites
features.description: Mark notes as favorites for quick access

features.name: AI Image Generation

features.user_journey: Notes → Type /ai image → Enter prompt → Image generated

features.name: AI Vision Analysis
features.description: Analyze images with AI (describe, OCR, custom questions)
features.user_journey: Notes → Insert image → AI Vision block analyzes

features.name: Storyboard Generation
features.description: Generate sequential multi-image storyboards with AI
features.user_journey: Notes → Type /ai storyboard → Enter frames → Storyboard generated

features.name: Video Analysis
features.description: Analyze uploaded videos (transcribe, describe, key scenes)
features.user_journey: Notes → Insert video → Video block analyzes

features.name: Text-to-Speech
features.description: Convert text to speech with customizable voices
features.user_journey: Notes → Insert TTS block → Enter text → Audio plays

features.name: Interactive HTML Artifacts
features.description: Embed interactive HTML/CSS/JS artifacts in notes
features.user_journey: Notes → Insert artifact block → Edit code → Interactive preview

features.name: Video Generation
features.description: Generate videos from text prompts
features.user_journey: Notes → Type /ai video → Enter prompt → Video generates

features.name: Slides Export
features.description: Export note content as PowerPoint slides
features.user_journey: Notes → Insert slides block → Define slides → Download PPTX

features.name: Chart/Diagram Generation
features.description: Generate charts (bar, line, pie) and diagrams (flowchart, sequence)
features.user_journey: Notes → Insert chart block → Enter data → Chart renders

features.name: Study Mode Integration
features.description: Create flashcards and quizzes from notes
features.user_journey: Notes → Click Study menu → Generate flashcard/quiz

features.name: Slash Commands
features.description: Command palette for quick actions and AI prompts
features.user_journey: Notes → Type / → Command list appears

features.name: Block References
features.description: Reference content from other notes with live sync
features.user_journey: Notes → Insert reference block → Select note → Reference updates automatically

features.name: Column Layouts
features.description: Split content into 2-3 columns
features.user_journey: Notes → Insert column block → Select columns → Content arranged

features.name: Voice Recording
features.description: Record speech and convert to text with Gemini transcription
features.user_journey: Notes → Click mic → Record → Transcript inserted

features.name: Note Tree Navigation
features.description: Hierarchical note tree with folder structure
features.user_journey: Notes → Browse note tree → Click note

overlaps.conflict_description: Different sync patterns - Notes uses auto-save (500ms debounce), IDE uses auto-save (2000ms debounce). Should unify to single sync service pattern.
Both workspaces use storage adapters but with different patterns. Notes uses NotesFileSyncService wrapper, IDE uses direct adapter access. Consolidation opportunity.
Both workspaces use UnifiedChatPanel but with different contexts. Notes has AIPromptDialog, IDE has AgentChatPanel. Should unify AI interface.
Same component used in both workspaces but with different data sources. Should use unified sync store.
